B. DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION:
1. Prior to evaluation of transcript of

lippines, must report to the Office concerned

The names of foreign students enrolled but

5. The Department should limit the number of
schools allowed to accopt foreign students, This
is to preclude delay to these students in complet-
ing their studies due to the dropping of subjects
(by the school) from the curriculum resulting from
low enrollment.
6, The Department should not allow the enroll-
ment in Thilippine schools of all foreigners belong-
ins to the catogory of tourists and others includ-
ing temporary visitors and deportees. lovever,
in the case of overstaying Chinese, great care
must be exercised in determining their status.
7. The Department should allow foreign stu-
dents to take up only collcge courses leading to
bachelor's, master's, or doctorate degrees; it
should not allow enrollment in the high school
or in the elementary school excest to children
of permanent foreign residents, or of foreign
diplomatic officials and of officials of ASA
countries residing in the Philippines, duly ac-
credited world organizations like the Ull, Asian
Bank, and/or etc.
8. The Department should provide the means
to dotermine the number of foreign students en-
rolled at present.
C. BURLAU OF IMMIGRATION:
1. The Bureau should help in providing the
means for determining the correct number of fo-
reign students in the Philippines at present.

ment of Foreign Affairs unless the foreign stu-
dent concerned presents the study permit for the

4. The Bureau should not grant extension
of stay to tomporary visitors, 1,c., tourists,

5. The Bureau should not allow teiporary

6. The Bureau must immedintely take steps
to deport any foreign student who fails to com-
ply with all regulations in reapect to his stu-

7. The Bureau should inform the Department
of Education of any Philippine school that vio-

1. Tho Bureau on a selective basis should

Stato. Any report of employment should imme-
diately be forwardod to the Bureau of Immigra-
tion as a basis for the cancellation of the en-
try permit and for initiation of action to de-

2. The Bureau in coordination with the
Bureau of Immigration shall be responsible for
the apprehension of foreign students not com-
plying with Philippine Inmigration laws and
regulations,
E. NATIONAL INTELLIGENCE COORDINATING AGENCY:
1. The NICA will maintain a list of fo-
reign students in the Philippines as provided
by the Department of Education, Department of
Foreien Affairs and the Bureau of Immigration.
2. The NICA will coordinate the activities
of other intelligence agencies regarding the
activities of these foreign students.
